accounts.disconnectSpotifyBody: Your Spotify library will be removed from Unison. Nothing changes on Spotify.
accounts.byokStep1: Create an app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard and tick Web API.
accounts.byokStep2: Add these redirect URIs to the app, then save it.
accounts.invalidClientId: That doesn't look like a Spotify Client ID.
accounts.byokUsers: In the app's User Management, add the email of the Spotify account you'll sign in with.
accounts.clientIdSaved: A Client ID is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
accounts.waiting: Approve Unison in your browser to finish.
accounts.waitingHint: Seeing INVALID_CLIENT in the browser? Check the Client ID, and that all three redirect URIs are added to the app exactly as shown.

errors.offline: You are offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.authCancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. Try connecting again.
errors.authTimeout: Sign-in timed out. Try connecting again.
errors.needsReconnect: Your account needs to sign in again. Reconnect it in Settings.
errors.invalidClientId: That Client ID was not accepted. Copy it again from the Spotify dashboard.
errors.redirectUriMismatch: The redirect URIs do not match. Add the exact URIs shown, then try again.
errors.noSpotifyDevice: Open Spotify on this PC or your phone, then pick it here.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds} s.
errors.youtubeQuotaExceeded: YouTube daily limit reached. Resets at {time}.
errors.notEmbeddable: This video can't be played outside YouTube. Open it on YouTube instead.
errors.notFound: That item is no longer available.
errors.upstream: The service had a problem ({status}). Try again in a moment.
errors.internal: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, restart Unison.
errors.userNotRegistered: This Spotify account isn't added to your developer app. Add its email under User Management in the Spotify dashboard, then connect again.
errors.noPlayableSource: This song can't play from any connected source here. Open it in its app instead.
errors.fileMissing: The file was moved or deleted. Use Locate file to find it.
errors.unsupportedFormat: Unison can't play this file type.
errors.drmProtected: This file is copy-protected (DRM) and can't be played.
errors.audiusUnavailable: Audius isn't reachable right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.youtubeEmbedBlocked: YouTube won't let this video play outside YouTube (error {code}).
errors.outputDeviceUnavailable: That audio output isn't available. Pick another one in Settings.
